experiments.scope: Target sha256-r41-prefix-v1 with the two-block 64-byte messages of proof Section 1. GEN_C is the normative freestanding C setup source. Before every request the organizer runs packaged Python BGen and BoundedEmitter as its byte-exact mirror, checks all 15 C fields, the source hash, q, and the 61159520df7c39782aa9280c39c88da645375d37da483d939820634b704580da SLP hash. The native/wasm counts are participant-run accounting. Each trial runs one complete width-16 attempt with the shipped search, table, cut rule, recovery, inverse, feed-forward, and fixed second block.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair contains distinct messages whose complete 41-step digests agree in the low 16 bits. Null returns are valid. Counts are program checks, not probability estimates.
